Ezviz CS-DP2C Smart Video Doorbell

The Ezviz CS-DP2C Wire-Free Peephole Smart Video Doorbell is a home security solution designed for modern households seeking convenience, clarity, and control. Engineered to fit a wide range of door types—with supported peephole diameters from 16.5 to 50 mm and door thicknesses between 35 to 105 mm—this smart doorbell offers hassle-free installation and a sleek, wire-free design. At its core is a powerful 1/3" progressive scan CMOS sensor paired with a 2.0 mm lens that delivers a stunning 1080p Full HD resolution at 15fps. With intuitive buttons for doorbell activation, power control, and screen wake-up, the CS-DP2C is designed for effortless operation. Though it doesn’t support face detection, its robust PIR-based intelligence alarm system ensures reliable motion-triggered alerts. Whether you're upgrading your home security system or looking for a smart, wire-free alternative to traditional peepholes, the Ezviz CS-DP2C offers a feature-rich, user-friendly experience that combines high-definition video, smart motion detection, and secure connectivity—all in one sleek package.
